jobs.title: Associate Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We are looking for an Associate Creative Strategist to support the North America Creative Strategy team. This role is designed for an emerging creative thinker who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves experimenting with AI tools and is excited about creative concepts for Snap’s largest advertising clients. The Associate Creative Strategist will focus on powering internal creative development, presentation building, trend research, and executional support with post-sale creative materials. This role will work closely with a team of Creative Strategists, Producers, and members of the Sales team to support advertising RFPs, brainstorms, and scalable creative workflows.

What You’ll Do:

Immerse yourself in Snapchat ad products, creative best practices, and platform storytelling principles.
Support members of the Creative Strategy team in the development of creative concepts, competitive research, creative audits and pitch materials.
Build presentation mocks, visual storytelling frameworks, and rapid concept explorations using AI-powered workflows and creative tools.
Participate in daily creative brainstorming sessions.
Partner closely with Production, Creative Strategy Leads, and Sales teams to support executional workflows.
Contribute to scalable systems, templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve team efficiency and throughput.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and speed.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Strong interest in advertising, storytelling, social content, creators, and digital culture.
Comfortable using AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate creative development and execution.
Strong design sensibility and presentation-building skills.
Experience with Google Slides, Gemini, ChatGPT, and other image-generating tools.
Ability to work quickly and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to receive feedback and iterate rapidly.
Curiosity about Snapchat, social platforms, and platform-native storytelling.
Strong written and verbal communication skills internally.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in English, marketing, communications, business management, or related area of study or equivalent years of experience.
1+ years of experience in a creative strategy, advertising, social content, design, production, marketing, or related fields.
Experience building presentations, creative concepts, or social-first marketing materials.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting creative pitches, brainstorms, or production workflows.
Understanding of Augmented Reality, social media platforms, creators, and digital advertising ecosystems.
Passion for internet culture, trends, creators, and emerging storytelling formats.
Ability to balance speed, creativity, and organization under tight timelines.
Experience leveraging AI tools and platforms (e.g., generative AI, image creation, storyboarding tools) to enhance creative ideation, streamline workflows, and scale strategic output.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

Compensation

In the United States, work locations are assigned a pay zone which determines the salary range for the position. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The starting pay may be negotiable within the salary range for the position. These pay zones may be modified in the future.

Zone A (CA, WA, NYC):

The base hourly range for this position is $35.09-$52.4 hourly.

Zone B:

The base hourly range for this position is $33.17-$50 hourly.

Zone C:

The base hourly range for this position is $29.8-$44.71 hourly.

This position is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Brand & Campaign
jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Campaigns to define and evolve how Bose looks, feels and shows up in the world.

This role will be responsible for defining Bose’s visual identity, establishing a distinctive and consistent brand expression across product launches, campaigns, experiences, and cultural activations. The Creative Director will lead the creative concepting and development of Bose’s most important product photography and video content, translating product innovation, design and new color collections into compelling creative that builds desire and strengthens the brand.

Beyond product launches, this person will guide how the Bose identity is applied across every major brand expression—from live experiences, events and partnership activations to talent seeding, packaging and physical environments. They will also lead the development of advertising and experiential work that brings Bose’s broader brand platform to life in culturally relevant and emotionally resonant ways.

The ideal candidate is a concept-driven creative leader with a sophisticated visual point of view, deep experience in product and brand storytelling, and the ability to move fluidly between defining creative systems and producing breakthrough work. They combine exceptional taste with strong leadership, translating a clear brand vision into work that is both highly distinctive and consistently executed.

What You’ll Do

Define Bose’s Visual Identity

Own and evolve Bose’s global visual identity, establishing the creative principles, design language and visual systems that define how the brand shows up.
Create a clear and differentiated point of view across photography, film, motion, graphic design, typography, color, composition and art direction.
Develop and maintain brand creative guidelines that give internal teams and external partners a strong framework without limiting creative ambition.
Ensure the Bose brand is recognizable, coherent and elevated across every consumer touchpoint.

Lead Product Photography and Video

Lead the creative concepting, art direction and production of Bose’s global product photography and video content.
Define the visual stories for major product launches, seasonal moments and new color collections.
Translate product design, technology and innovation into work that creates emotional desire—not simply functional understanding.
Select and direct photographers, directors, designers, stylists and production partners to deliver work at the highest creative standard.

Serve as the Creative North Star Across Brand Design

Set the creative direction for how Bose’s brand identity is applied across experiences, partnerships, events, retail environments, talent seeding and physical brand expressions.
Guide the design of seeding kits, packaging, installations, event environments and partnership activations to ensure they feel unmistakably Bose.
Provide senior creative leadership and clear decision-making across internal teams, agencies and external collaborators.
Establish a consistent standard of craft while allowing each execution to respond authentically to its audience, partner and cultural context.

Bring the Bose Brand Platform to Life

Lead the development of video, experiential and integrated creative work that builds and expresses Bose’s overarching brand platform.
Translate the brand strategy into compelling concepts, narratives and consumer experiences.
Develop work that demonstrates the emotional and cultural power of sound while reinforcing Bose’s authority in audio.
Identify new creative formats and opportunities to bring the platform to life across film, content, live experiences and cultural moments.
Ensure product storytelling and brand storytelling work together as one connected creative system.

Build and Inspire Creative Teams

Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams across art direction, design and creative development.
Create a culture of high standards, constructive critique, experimentation and creative ambition.
Build strong relationships across Brand, Product, Partnerships, Experiential, Communications and Marketing.
Represent a clear creative point of view with senior leaders, agency partners and external collaborators.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of New York, New York is: $180,900-$248,775.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

‎
